meta.title: Pricing — Mobilcab
meta.description: Now: Free plan (Cut list, unlimited exports) + Founding Partner list. At subscription launch: Free with 3 exports + paid Cut list; Founding Partners get the first 2 months free.

hero.label: Pricing
hero.title: Free on Cut list now. 2 months free at launch for Founding Partners.
hero.body: Right now you get free 3D design and unlimited cut-list export. After paid plans launch, Free will include 3 exports per account, and the paid Cut list plan keeps unlimited exports. You join the program for free. At subscription launch (where Cut list will cost less than a single sheet of melamine board per month), you get **the first 2 months free** on your chosen plan, with no obligation now. Anyone who joins later pays the standard price.

more.title: More detail
more.body: How Free differs from Cut list and how Founding Partner works — on the [FAQ](/en/faq/). Features we ship in stages are on the [product roadmap](/en/roadmap/).

note: We don't charge anything until paid plans launch. Until then you get full free access to 3D design and unlimited cut-list export. As we ship new features, you'll find them on the [product roadmap](/en/roadmap/), and as a Founding Partner you get **the first 2 months free** on your chosen plan.
